title: Water Bottle Stations Expand
transcript: The university will install six additional drinking water stations before the start of the autumn term. The first stations, opened in the sports centre last year, were used more often than expected. The new ones will be placed near lecture halls so that students can fill bottles between classes. Each station will show how many disposable bottles it has helped save. The university will also give a reusable bottle to every student attending the new student welcome event.

questions.prompt: Why is the university adding more stations?
questions.explanation: 原有饮水点的使用量超过预期。

options: An estimate of disposable bottles saved.
questions.answer: An estimate of disposable bottles saved.
